en: You have come. Then we will dance, as the dancers before us danced for the bird of the rainbow.
The five Kimono Girls dance before the bell...
The great bell rings out over Ecruteak City!
A Pokémon of rainbow fire has come down to the roof!
Ho-Oh rose into the sky in a trail of rainbow light and was gone...
Ho-Oh has seen you. There is one more bird our dances are for: the guardian of the sea, deep in the Whirl Islands.
This feather was left in our care. Take it to the islands' deepest cave, and the guardian may come to you as well.
Step up before the bell when you are ready, and we will begin.
Ho-Oh is waiting for you. Go to it, and show it who you are.
Ho-Oh has flown, but it will come back to the Bell Tower. Its kind always does, for someone it has chosen.
Ho-Oh has chosen you. Look after it, and it will bring you a rainbow every day of your life.
